visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a pink floral robe sits on a wooden platform inside a high-ceilinged hotel room. She pulls back heavy grey curtains to reveal a massive window looking out over a lush green river valley and mountains. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting. (2) Aerial drone footage shows a large multi-story hotel building nestled in a forested mountain valley. A river runs alongside the building with rocky banks. (3) The woman walks through a modern hotel lobby pulling a purple suitcase, accompanied by a man. The lobby features bright white walls and high ceilings. (4) The scene shifts to the lobby interior featuring vibrant geometric patterns on the walls and colorful modern seating. Indigenous dancers in traditional red and white attire perform for guests. (5) In a split-screen view, the woman explores a loft-style hotel room with a green accent wall and a large wooden staircase. She stretches her arms out over a large bed, looking out the massive floor-to-ceiling windows. (6) Close-up of a stone-tiled bathroom with a private square hot spring tub. The woman is later seen soaking in the tub, holding a wooden ladle. (7) Outdoor scene at a hot spring resort. The woman, now in a white bikini, walks across a wooden deck toward several circular hot spring pools with different colored waters (green, blue). Lush trees surround the area. (8) Nighttime view of the same outdoor hot springs, illuminated with blue and purple LED lights. The woman enters a steaming pool. (9) The woman plays a fishing game at an outdoor poolside area. Cut to images of children on water slides and in bumper boats. (10) Indoor game room with an air hockey table and archery range. The woman and a man play air hockey, then practice archery with red bows. (11) A dining room with round tables and orange chairs. A large seafood and vegetable hot pot boils on a portable stove. The woman eats at a table with other guests. (12) The woman and others participate in a craft workshop, folding yellow towels into animal shapes. (13) The woman walks through the lobby with her suitcase to check out. She returns to the outdoor hot springs for a final soak before walking across a long red suspension bridge over the valley.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features luxury hotel interiors including a high-ceiling loft, a vibrant lobby with Atayal motifs, and a large dining hall. Outdoors, there are tiered hot spring pools, a river valley with rocky cliffs, and a long suspension bridge.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-tempo acoustic guitar melody supported by a steady drum beat. A female narrator speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone, her speech rate fast and energetic. Occasional 'whoosh' transition sound effects occur during visual cuts. (2) As the video shows the lobby and dance, the BGM remains consistent, but ambient room tone and distant rhythmic clapping can be faintly heard. The narrator maintains a cheerful prosody. (3) The audio texture shifts slightly as the scene moves to the outdoor hot springs; a subtle 'splash' or liquid sound effect is layered over the music. The narrator's voice remains dominant and clear. (4) During the dinner scene, the sound of a boiling hot pot (simmering bubbles) is audible beneath the music. The narrator describes the food with an increased pitch variability to show excitement. (5) Transition sound effects like 'dings' and 'pops' are used during the game room and DIY segments to emphasize actions. The background music continues without pause, maintaining a major-key tonality until the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Arrival -> Room Tour -> Lobby Activities -> Hot Spring Experience -> Dining -> Post-Check-out Perks.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive travel guide and promotion for Uni-Resort Guguan, highlighting its scenic views, cultural performances, diverse hot spring facilities, family-friendly activities, and generous post-checkout policies to attract tourists.
